description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Shinsect Riot Style, Weapon Focus (Club or Tonfa)

Benefit: While in Shinsect Riot Style and wielding a club or tonfa, you are treated as if you have the Bludgeoner feat when you choose to deal non-lethal damage to an opponent. In addition, you can perform a Forceful Strike as a standard action, dealing a Fortitude save or the opponent becomes staggered for 1 round.

system.requirements: Shinsect Riot Style, Weapon Focus (Club or Tonfa)
